title: plugins/runs: the agent's graph-run tools (runs_start, runs_list, runs_read) over RA's /hub/runs/a/<verb>, shipped and trusted by the installer like plugins/term
operator_decision: 2026-10-08 (TRACK.md:174, the user's A + C). Under C, agents start runs THROUGH THE PERCH, and the tool the agent calls is a plugin in Minerva's plugins/, like plugins/term (slice T3). The route is slice RA. The person answers a run's parks in the page, so the plugin has no answer, cancel or abandon tool. Not reopened here.

live_check:
Everything runs in WSL on port 48147, with this slice's own builds:
- the perch and fake_eidolon with --features test-bins, from the worktree (RA merged in), CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$HOME/.cache/minerva-PR-target;
- the vendored eidolon, built into the same private target.
No model is called anywhere, and no token is in argv, env, a URL or a log.

1. Stub. `RUNS_STUB_PORT=48147 bash plugins/runs/tests/shape.sh` passes every case, and `bash plugins/runs/tests/bundle.sh` passes. Then nothing listens on 48147.

2. The real route, from a workflow run (it must be refused).
   - Setup:
     - B=$HOME/.cache/PR-live, the fake perch's tree T=$B/minerva-fake-perch-48147 (fake-perch.sh:42-43), the eidolon home E=$B/eid, and `mkdir -p -m 0700 $E/.config/eidolon` before the perch starts.
     - Fake perch: `PORT=48147 FAKE_PERCH_BASE=$B FAKE_PERCH_ARGS="--runs-token-file $E/.config/eidolon/minerva-runs.token --agent-url-file $E/.config/eidolon/minerva-perch.url" perch/tests/live/fake-perch.sh >/dev/null`. The login URL is discarded. The token is written straight into the eidolon home, so it is never copied.
     - Under `env -i HOME=$E XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$E/.config XDG_DATA_HOME=$E/.local/share XDG_STATE_HOME=$E/.local/state XDG_CACHE_HOME=$E/.cache PATH=/usr/bin:/bin`: copy plugins/runs and the tests' probe plugin into $E/.config/eidolon/plugins, and apply shape.sh's as_installer (the untrust, the RUNS_VOUCHED trusts, the three grants).
   - Run the probe workflow with --provider mock and --yolo. runs_start, runs_list and runs_read each answer a tool error with "the perch answered 403" and "runs tools work in chats this Minerva opened". A wrong token would be 401, and a wrong path an empty 404 or a 401, so this shows the plugin reached RA's route with the runs token from a socket that is not a door.
   - $T/minerva/runs.json does not exist.
3. The url file. Overwrite $E/.config/eidolon/minerva-perch.url with `http://localhost:48147/` and run the probe again. Each call is refused with "no perch address in ~/.config/eidolon/minerva-perch.url", and $T/minerva/runs.json still does not exist. (The perch logs no request lines at RUST_LOG=info, fake-perch.sh:147, so its log cannot show what was not sent; the stub's urlfile case in step 1 is the proof that nothing is sent.)
4. Leaks. `grep -rF -f $E/.config/eidolon/minerva-runs.token` over $T/perch.out, $T/perch.err, $E/.local and $E/.cache (the probe runs' journals) finds no match.
5. Stop. kill -TERM the perch and wait. minerva-runs.token is gone (on_exit; the url file was changed, so it is left, AG's compare-before-unlink). Then `PORT=48147 perch/tests/live/fake-perch.sh --stop` and `rm -rf $B`.

6. A real door, the agent's own path (positive). X0's isolation recipe on 127.0.0.1:48147 (X0.json "Setup": env -i, temp HOME and XDG_*, member config default_model mock, swarm off, no provider credential), with this slice's perch and --eidolon the vendored eidolon:
   - Perch flags: --run-graphs wiki-hop, --plugins-dir a temp copy of eidolon-plugins, and --runs-token-file and --agent-url-file under the temp HOME's .config/eidolon.
   - plugins/runs is installed and as_installer applied in the temp config.
   - A test-only user tool named `grep` (the mock's second scripted call, eidolon/crates/providers/src/catalog.rs:877-881; X0's probe pattern) calls, through eidolon::tool_call:
       runs_start {graph:"wiki-hop", args:{start:"Cat", goal:"Felidae"}}
       runs_list {}
       runs_read {rid:"r1", wait_s:30}
     and returns their answers.
   - A new chat in yolo, and one `say`. Check that:
     - the tool output holds {"rid":"r1","state":"running","chat":"<the chat's id>"};
     - the list is [r1];
     - the read leads with the note line and ends in a terminal state with its fixed `said`. refused or failed is expected: no browser service or jev runs here. If refused, the said is RA's "eidolon would not start this graph on this machine ... tell the operator" and names no arg. The read has none of "eidolon plugins", why, out or err;
     - with the master header file, GET /hub/runs?chat=<id> lists r1.
   - The same `say` from a second chat: its runs_read r1 is "the perch answered 404: ... no run r1 in this chat".
   - Step 4's grep over the perch logs and the temp HOME's eidolon journals finds nothing. X0's manifests of the operator's ~/.config/eidolon and ~/Minerva are unchanged.
   - Stop, and check that the runs token file is gone.

Browser pane: if GP-a has merged, the orchestrator opens a fresh login URL straight into the pane before step 6's stop. The chat's graph strip shows r1 with its end state, with no page code added.
risk:
- Vouching runs_start, the user's question. Vouched, an agent in auto starts a browser-driving run without an ask. The bounds:
  - RA's caps: one holder, 15 minutes per running child, 20 starts an hour and 60 a day per chat (a rate, not a bound: RA's rate step), and the agent's own graph list, --agent-run-graphs (wiki-hop by default, never widened by the page's --run-graphs);
  - parks go to the person;
  - the run shows in the chat's strip.
  A parked run holds the browser until the person acts. Not vouched, every start asks in auto, as mail_send does.
- Prompt injection through a run's report or question: page text from the web. runs_read leads with the note line, the descriptions call both untrusted, and RA clips each to 2000 bytes.
- The bash bypass is not closed here. The descriptions steer the model to runs_start, but the stock table still allows `eidolon workflow run` and `eidolon plugins trust` through bash (eidolon/crates/rune/policy.rn:331-333). That is slice GW (notes).
- The token in transit: the same as term's (plugins/term/README.md:39-42). api_request has no no-proxy option, and a door's NO_PROXY lists loopback.
- Older perches. A perch from before RA usually gets no call at all: the launchers give it no --runs-token-file (perch_has, bin/perch-open.sh:269-281; nix/minerva.sh:276-284), so the host's "nothing is in" error fires first. With a token file left behind (a newer perch that crashed, so on_exit never removed it), the old perch's master gate answers 401 (serve.rs:376-385), which is the 401 sentence. The empty 404 comes only from an RA perch that does not know the verb. None of these starts anything.
- Merge order. PR after RA. Three open slices share its files:
  - SA3 (held): installer/src/plugins.rs and installer/src/plugins/tests.rs (trust_one, no_plugin_name_makes_a_vouch_for_term_send);
  - I2 (fix round pending the user): both launchers, installer/tests/perch_open.rs, installer/tests/common/mod.rs, installer/README.md and a line of installer/src/plugins.rs;
  - R2c (held): the help fixture and the_fixtures_are_what_they_claim.
  Every grant is by anchor, so whichever lands second rebases; the arms are independent. None of them is a dependency: waiting on I2 or R2c would hold PR on decisions that have nothing to do with runs.
notes:
Bash-started workflow runs: the reader recommends a separate slice, so no guard row is in PR. Slice GW, to spec now and launch after PR:
- Files: perch/src/guard/rows.rn, perch/src/guard/mod.rs, perch/src/guard/README.md, perch/tests/guard.rs.
- A deny row, in every mode, for argv `eidolon [--config X | --yolo ...] workflow run <path ending in /jev> wiki-hop` and for `eidolon ... workflow resume --plugin <.../jev>`. Its REASON names runs_start ("start graph runs with runs_start, so the operator sees them; the perch shares one browser").
- Whether GW also denies `eidolon plugins trust|untrust|grant|revoke|service approve` from an agent's bash is a separate question to the user. The stock table allows any `eidolon ...` (policy.rn:331-333), so an agent in auto or yolo can vouch term_send itself and undo D6.
- Also the operator's call: a row for an agent's shell reading <home>/runs.json, <home>/runs/ or the perch's token file (RA's risk). It is a speed bump only: a same-uid process can spell the read many ways.
- The rows are the perch's (G1's guard rows reach every generated policy and the runs' config, proc.rs:84-93). eidolon is not edited.
Trust is re-applied only on unsettled passes (T3's rule, plugins/term/README.md:52-56). A vouch the member changes by hand stays until the next install, update or full sync, as term's does.
No answer, cancel or abandon tool: the person answers parks in the page (user decision 2026-10-08). RA's routes have none either, so a tool for them would hit the empty 404.

The launchers give --runs-token-file to the perch on the default port only (perch-open.sh:275-281), so a second perch never overwrites the member's file. Until PR merges, an installed Minerva has neither the tools nor a runs token file.

installer/build.sh and nix/plugins.nix copy plugins/runs with no edit (build.sh:67-85, plugins.nix:14-29). The help-fixture lines are copied from the real `perch --help` of the merged master, never typed.
X0 (the real-eidolon smoke) should gain a runs row on its next pass: the step-6 probe through a door, plus the strip in the page.
Never edits eidolon. No model call: the mock provider and stubs only.
